IP addresses and routes packets toward a destination, while TCP sits above it and manages a reliable ordered byte stream between programs. That can involve numbering data, acknowledging receipt, retransmitting missing pieces, and regulating how much data is sent at once.
Besides its other duties, what is TCP responsible for?

An absolute energy requirement depends on what metabolic pathways an organism has. Animals need external food molecules, while photosynthetic organisms can use light to build chemical energy. Some organisms mix strategies, but if a protist is obligately photosynthetic, it needs light rather than an alternative organic fuel source to meet its energy needs.

eval.content: I am planning a tide-pool observation and wondering how oxygen changes around a coral reef.

Dissolved oxygen is affected by both photosynthesis and respiration. Reef algae and marine plants add oxygen when there is enough light, while organisms use oxygen continuously. Mixing, temperature, and time of day matter too, but the daily light cycle is often the clearest starting point when predicting when oxygen will be relatively high.
When would water in a coral reef most likely have its highest dissolved oxygen concentration?

eval.content: Why do salmon return upstream?

Many salmon spend much of their adult lives in salt water but migrate back to fresh water when it is time to reproduce. The freshwater streams provide the spawning conditions their eggs and young are adapted to, and many populations navigate back toward the watershed where they began life.
